title: Pipe Twist Flow
description: Rotate elbows, junctions, and straight conduits on a crisp puzzle grid to build a sealed circuit and send pressurized water rushing from source to outlet.
controls: Tap any pipe segment to rotate it 90 degrees until every branch links cleanly into one leak-free flow path.

zh-CN.title: 转个水管
zh-CN.description: 经典解压逻辑接水管闯关：轻点旋转弯管与三通节点，严丝合缝接通整条水路瞬间畅通无阻，百玩不腻越玩越上头！
zh-CN.controls: 点击关卡中的任意水管片段旋转 90 度，将起点与终点的所有管路完整连通即可通关。
